title: Functions, traced
description: Function curves drawn by a tracer: each curve draws itself behind a glowing point with dashed drops to both axes, so you see x turn into y; the curve being drawn glows and its name lands at its end. Afterwards the tracer keeps riding the curves one after another. Built-in functions only (no eval).

props.curves: required, 1-3 of {fn, label}: fn is one of step, sigmoid, relu, tanh, linear, parabola
props.title: heading
